chunks: And ʿAlī ibn Mahziyār narrated from Abū Jaʿfar Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī al-Thānī عليه السلام, who said:
I said to him, "May I be your ransom, is the ziyārah of al-Riḍā عليه السلام superior, or the ziyārah of Abī ʿAbdillāh al-Ḥusayn عليه السلام?"

He said, "The ziyārah of my father عليه السلام is superior, and that is because Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام is visited by all people, while my father عليه السلام is visited only by the select among the Shīʿah."

key_terms.أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْحُسَيْنِ: Imam al-Ḥusayn ibn ʿAlī عليه السلام
key_terms.أَفْضَلُ: more excellent or superior in merit
key_terms.الرِّضَا: Imam ʿAlī ibn Mūsā al-Riḍā عليه السلام
key_terms.الشِّيعَةِ: the Shīʿah, the followers devoted to the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام
key_terms.زِيَارَةُ: visitation to the shrine of a sacred figure

ai.seo_question: Which is more excellent: the ziyārah of Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام or the ziyārah of Imam al-Ḥusayn عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith records Imam Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī al-Thānī عليه السلام explaining that visiting Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام is more excellent than visiting Imam al-Ḥusayn عليه السلام in this specific comparison. The reason given is that Imam al-Ḥusayn عليه السلام is visited by everyone, while Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام is visited only by the select among the Shīʿah, indicating a special distinction in that visitation.
